title: 2019 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Nasser Al-Attiyah / Matthieu Baumel (Toyota Gazoo Racing SA) and Toby Price (Red Bull KTM Factory Racing)
summary: The 2019 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its South America era: 9 stage towns and bivouacs through Peru. Winners — Cars: Nasser Al-Attiyah / Matthieu Baumel (Toyota Gazoo Racing SA); Bikes: Toby Price (Red Bull KTM Factory Racing); Quads: Nicolás Cavigliasso (Drag'on Rally); Trucks: Eduard Nikolaev / Evgenii Iakovlev / Vladimir Rybakov (Kamaz Master); UTVs: Francisco López Contardo / Álvaro León (South Racing Can-Am).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
